patch_description:
Choose GPUs using the KVPR after adding each model, rather than the current KVPR. This directly optimizes the minimax objective at each greedy decision and avoids placing a high-pressure model on an apparently empty GPU when its reduced remaining memory would create a large KVPR.

After the initial feasible placement, apply strict-improvement local search. Single-model moves and model swaps are accepted only when they reduce the global maximum KVPR while preserving memory feasibility. Swaps handle common GPU-memory fragmentation cases where a beneficial rebalance cannot be achieved by a one-way move.
